name: Balance
definition: Numerical representation of the net increases and decreases in an account at a specific point in time.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the nature of a balance.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time at which the balance is or will be available.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the balance is a credit or a debit balance. A zero balance is considered to be a credit balance

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Specifies the date and time at which the balance is calculated.

ProcessingRestriction.name: Processing Restriction
ProcessingRestriction.definition: Specifies the type of balance processing restrictions that must be applied.

OpeningClosingCode.name: Opening Closing Code
OpeningClosingCode.definition: Specifies whether the balance is an opening or a closing one.

AssetHolding.name: Asset Holding
AssetHolding.definition: Specifies in terms of value and quantity the assets held in a balance.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account or sub-account for which a balance is calculated.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Set of elements used to provide interest information that applies to the balance.

BalanceEntry.name: Balance Entry
BalanceEntry.definition: Credit or debit postings used to calculate a balance.
